summary: Haitian, speaks Haitian Creole and French natively, fluent in English, software engineer with a background in electronic engineering, specializes in mobile and web development (React Native, Laravel, Node.js), strong interest in programming languages and computer science theory, avid reader of science fiction and fantasy (favorite series: "The Stormlight Archive"), enjoys speed reading, digital painting, and drawing, uses Apple products (Mac Mini, MacBook Air, iPad), prefers open-source software and Linux (Arch Linux, customized environments), engaged in freelance work, values autonomy and efficiency in work, critical of ad-driven business models, interested in philosophy and psychology, has a family structure that includes a partner, lives in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, experiences challenges with local infrastructure (electricity, internet), actively seeks to improve personal productivity and organization (using tools like Things, Bear, and Doppler).
